name: asic-tools
description: Agent-harness tooling for Claude Code + Warp. PRP lifecycle: idea-refine (upstream ideation one-pager), prp-draft (research-first PRP generator), prp-review (adversarial 6-lens review gate), and prp-implement (two-phase drift-checked executor). Plus asicdash (config + usage dashboard: audit visible and invisible config, Claude usage heatmap), scaffold (standards-enforced Python bootstrap), release (multi-location version bump + changelog), and sync-rules (deploy the bundled global engineering rules to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md). Plus diagram (draw.io architecture/network/system diagram generator: NL→diagram, code-to-diagram, CLI export).
